howItWorks.title: Describe your vision
howItWorks.body: Tell the agent what you want to build in plain language. No technical specs required — describe the problem, the users, and the outcome you need.

howItWorks.title: Agent architects the solution
howItWorks.body: The AI analyzes your requirements, selects the optimal tech stack, designs the architecture, and breaks the build into structured milestones.

howItWorks.title: Iterative development
howItWorks.body: The agent writes, tests, and refines the code in real time. You review progress at each milestone and steer the direction with natural language feedback.

howItWorks.title: Deploy & iterate
howItWorks.body: Receive production-ready code with deployment scripts, documentation, and test coverage. Continue iterating with the agent as your product evolves.
